description: This file is a script that sets up and runs an asynchronous pipeline involving audio input/output, speech-to-text, language model interactions, and text-to-speech, specifically for an interactive AI assistant or chatbot application.

classes.name: LLMContext
classes.description: Represents the conversational context for the LLM, holding message history.

classes.name: LLMContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Handles aggregation of user and assistant responses within the conversation context.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Defines the sequence of processing steps for the conversation pipeline.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline and its parameters for execution.

classes.name: PipelineParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters controlling pipeline behavior, like metrics collection.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: Sets up and runs the asynchronous speech interaction pipeline, integrating speech recognition, language model, and TTS services.

methods.name: __main__
methods.description: Entry point that runs the main async function to start the pipeline.
